source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Απολλώνιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The same day's listing carries a second Απολλώνιος, one of the Twenty-four Martyrs beheaded with Lucia and Rix in 301; that is a separate entry with a separate page and a different death, and the settled rule that two entries on one calendar are two commemorations is what keeps them apart. The corpus's four other men of the name — Apollonius of Sardis, Apollonius the Anchorite, Apollonius the Reader and Apollonius the companion of Proclus — are all on other days. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
